foie | Cirrhose compensée | Échographie.description: This is from a core biopsy of the liver of a patient who denied use of alcohol (despite her family's claims to the contrary). The liver had multiple large nodules on CT scan, and cancer was suspected. Despite two biopsy procedures under ultrasound guidance, all we could find was cirrhosis, complete with other features of alcoholic liver disease, including steatosis and Mallory hyalin, shown here. Pathological and histological images courtesy of Ed Uthman at flickr.

foie | Cirrhose compensée | Échographie.description: Doppler ultrasonography of the portal vein in a 77 year old man with alcoholic cirrhosis . There is a mild decrease in flow velocity (less than 16 cm/s), which may indicate portal hypertension , although not enough for diagnosis in this case since the diameter of the vein was normal. There is mild pulsatility but not more than can be seen in healthy adults.
